title: U.S.-NEW YORK-ANCIENT CHINA-RITUAL BRONZES-EXHIBITION
text:
Xinhua
06 Mar 2025, 04:46 GMT+10
(250305) -- NEW YORK, March 5, 2025 (Xinhua) -- A visitor views a kneeling figure dating back to the Warring States period (475 BC-221 BC) during a press preview of an exhibition titled Eternal Offerings: Chinese Ritual Bronzes from the Minneapolis Institute of Art, at China Institute Gallery in New York, the United States, on March 5, 2025. Over 70 Chinese ritual bronzes from 12th century BC in the Shang dynasty to 1st-2nd century AD in the Han dynasty will be on display at China Institute Gallery, according to China Institute in America. (Xinhua/Zhang Fengguo)
